about: Wall bench modelled as a generic product: epoxy-resin worktop on a 4-drawer unit and a sink cupboard (pair of doors) with knee space between, recessed plinth, service spine with 4 twin sockets, 3 gas turrets and a data outlet, glass reagent shelf on brackets, resin sink with gooseneck tap and wrist levers. Geometry is drawn at the 1800_Wall type; the other types share it until a parametric pass. Reference: query: casework lab bench wall casework hospital; images: https://www.google.com/search?tbm=isch&q=casework+lab+bench+wall+casework+hospital; basis: generic product; brand, model and supplier open for review
